decisions.implementation: Blade is extruded 1.6 mm including its lower tongue and upper bearing shaft; not imposed on unrelated components.

decisions.proposedDefault: 4.4 mm tongue, .15 mm total socket/diametral bearing allowance; printer/material dependent, adhesive required for fixed foot joint.

decisions.purpose: Stiffer beam and foot, with at least 1.4 mm backing under .6 mm engraving.
Twelve stronger accessible bed-flat runners instead of source .21/.22 mm carrier. Safe cutter tests release three parts plus carrier.

decisions.newDesign: Beam length 64–84 sets nominal radius 44–64; shoulder height 10–18; pencil bore 6.4–9; foot 30–38. Round bearing clears rectangular shaft diagonal by configured total gap. Full rotation and lift-off are checked with actual solids.

adaptation: Original parametric compass beam, shouldered pivot blade, gravity bearing and socket foot replace source ship outlines and assembly. Shared maker-studio/import helpers are reused; mechanism, dimensions, assembly poses and mechanical tests are new. No convex-hull geometry replacement.
sourceDefects: Nonwatertight source and 27 edge-adjacent components are evidence, not silently repaired. Reconstruction uses genuine Manifold CSG, not raw mesh redistribution.
units: Millimeters assumed; STL contains no unit metadata. User STL requires explicit confirmation.
